sloka: जटा भार धरस्य एव वल्कल अजिन वाससः ।को वधेन मम अर्थी स्यात् किम् वा अस्य अपकृतम् मया ॥२-६३-३१॥
transliteration: jaṭā bhāra dharasya eva valkala ajina vāsasaḥ ।ko vadhena mama arthī syāt kim vā asya apakṛtam mayā ॥2-63-31॥

translations.english: 'Who wants to kill me who lives like an ascetic with matted hair and wearing bark or the skin of an antelope? What harm have I done to him?
